# TreeView markup reference

TreeView nodes, expansion, and selection.

### TreeView

Receiver: `TreeView`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `ClearContainer(PrepareContainerHandler<ItemContainer, T> clear)` |  | Releases what PrepareContainer attached outside the template context, before the container takes another item. Most hooks need no counterpart: context subscriptions and container properties are undone for you. |
| `Collapse(TreeViewNode node)` |  | Collapses a node. |
| `Expand(TreeViewNode node)` |  | Expands a node. |
| `ExpandTrigger(TreeViewExpandTrigger value)` | `ExpandTrigger` | Sets which user interactions toggle node expansion. |
| `HorizontalScroll(ScrollMode value)` | `HorizontalScroll` | Sets the horizontal scroll mode, Auto by default, so items wider than the viewport scroll horizontally. |
| `Indent(double value)` | `Indent` | Sets the horizontal indentation per tree level. |
| `ItemHeight(double value)` | `ItemHeight` | Sets the height of each tree node row. |
| `ItemPadding(Thickness value)` | `ItemPadding` | Sets the padding around each node's text. |
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, FrameworkElement> build, Action<FrameworkElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> bind, Action<FrameworkElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> unbind = null)` |  | Sets the node template using delegate-based templating. |
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, TElement> build, Action<TElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> bind, Action<TElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> unbind = null)` |  | Sets the node template; the bind callback receives the root the build callback returned. |
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, TElement> build, Action<TElement, TItem> bind)` |  | Sets the node template from a root element and a bind callback that needs only the item. |
| `ItemTemplate(IDataTemplate template)` | `ItemTemplate` | Sets the node template. |
| `Items(IReadOnlyList<T> roots, Func<T, IReadOnlyList<T>> childrenSelector, Func<T, string> textSelector = null, Func<T, object> keySelector = null, Func<T, bool> isExpandableSelector = null)` |  | Sets a hierarchical items source using a children selector. |
| `ItemsSource(IReadOnlyList<TreeViewNode> items)` | `ItemsSource` | Sets the items source. |
| `ItemsSource(ITreeItemsView itemsView)` | `ItemsSource` | Sets the items source directly from an ITreeItemsView. |
| `OnCollapsing(Action<TreeViewExpansionEventArgs> handler)` | `event Collapsing` | Adds a handler that runs immediately before a tree item is collapsed. |
| `OnExpanding(Action<TreeViewExpansionEventArgs> handler)` | `event Expanding` | Adds a handler that runs immediately before a tree item is expanded. |
| `OnSelectedIndicesChanged(Action handler)` | `event SelectedIndicesChanged` | Subscribes handler to SelectedIndicesChanged. Occurs when the set of selected rows changes (multi-select). |
| `OnSelectedNodeChanged(Action<TreeViewNode> handler)` | `event SelectedNodeChanged` | Adds a selected node changed event handler. |
| `OnSelectionChanged(Action<object> handler)` | `event SelectionChanged` | Adds a selection changed event handler. |
| `PrepareContainer(PrepareContainerHandler<ItemContainer, T> prepare)` |  | Configures the container placed around each row once its content is bound, so behavior can be attached to the whole row, indent and expander included, instead of to the template. |
| `SelectedItem(object value)` | `SelectedItem` | Sets the selected item as an object: the SelectedNode for TreeViewNode -based items, or the typed item for a TreeItemsView. |
| `SelectedNode(TreeViewNode value)` | `SelectedNode` | Sets the currently selected tree node. |
| `SelectionMode(ItemsSelectionMode value)` | `SelectionMode` | Sets the selection mode; multi-selection needs an items source that supports it (e.g. TreeItemsView), otherwise the mode stays Single. |
| `Toggle(TreeViewNode node)` |  | Toggles a node expansion state. |
